field_policy.consumer_claims: Bind all actual score/rank/probability/economic/sizing/recommendation/hedge/fill claims for that consumer. Apply every matching rule and the exact OPT-094 consumer verdict. Do not globally declare claims empty.
field_policy.consumer_scope: Standalone scientific audit, Prophet candidate and Prophet outcome review have different consumers. prophet_candidate adds OPT-070; prophet_outcome_review adds OPT-079 where the original rule applies.
field_policy.expression_policy: Use the existing admitted deterministic prospective policy when instantiated. sparse_selector triggers OPT-075; constrained_optimizer triggers OPT-063. Freeze before outcomes.
field_policy.iv_source_method: Qualified matched-quote IV and fitted surface are distinct. fitted_surface requires OPT-055. Select by the actual input; neither is a nominal bypass.
field_policy.optimization_claim: The first user-authored comparison needs no optimizer. A later constrained-search task must bind its actual objective. Physical-probability expected utility triggers OPT-091; do not relabel delta/risk-neutral density as physical probability.
field_policy.population_context_contract: Bind exact source lineage for OPT-085; context_audit_v2 triggers OPT-019 when actually consumed. Unrelated admitted populations do not inherit a blanket gate.
field_policy.population_identity: Bind separately for OA candidate/expression/outcome, actual order/fills, known-book hedge or another explicitly admitted population. Preserve every matching original formation/publication/cost/chronology receipt.
field_policy.probability_endpoint: Bind the exact event and horizon. target_before_stop requires the original additional path/barrier/censoring/calibration receipt even when requires is empty.
field_policy.quote_ruler: Bind separately for Trade Lab long/vertical cost context and OA-3 long-option outcome review. The latter uses the actual oa3_long_option trigger. Never globally apply the one-long-contract ruler to a spread.
field_policy.quote_scope: Bind the actual OPT-064 cost/search population. Selected-contract quotes can support that narrower comparison. Full-chain consumption triggers OPT-018.
field_policy.release_data_scope: Initial consolidated release is qualified aggregates and settled books/reports. Any included intraday_full_chain lens triggers OPT-025/046; actual equity print streaming alone is a different source family.
field_policy.release_features: Settled consolidation and the integrated vertical include reachable reproducible_exports, so OPT-040 plus its original dependencies apply. Add saved_layouts/sharing only when actually included. A narrower precursor must prove the excluded controls are outside its scope.
field_policy.release_source_features: Derive from full lineage, including filter/selection and background inputs. prior_session_moneyness and ad1_producer trigger their original source/consumer receipts. False requires affirmative unused-lineage evidence; unknown blocks affected dispatch.
field_policy.selected_family: Bind the exact directional/range/variance/hedge_utility/execution_cost family and horizon. Only its applicable original verdicts apply; sibling success is not a universal dependency.
field_policy.selected_pilot: Only the original supported pilot for the instantiated task. P1/P2/P3/P4/P5/P6 preserve their registered domains/endpoints. P5's call-and-put SPY/QQQ/IWM book cannot be silently reduced to current call-only pricing.
field_policy.source_scope: Bind the actual OPT-060 repricing population. Exact selected expression is the initial policy; every required leg must be complete. Full-book/full-chain use triggers OPT-018; do not shrink the declared scope to evade consumed membership.
field_policy.structure_scope: Initial core comparison: stock, qualified long call, qualified same-expiry defined-risk call vertical, wait. Additional templates trigger OPT-065 for that actual domain.

original_dispatch_contract.unconditional_dependencies: Every dependencies item needs its accepted receipt before the bounded build task proceeds.
original_dispatch_contract.conditional_dependencies: Evaluate every rule against explicit frozen bindings. Matching rules are cumulative AND requirements; list membership within one rule is OR. Unbound or unknown is BLOCKED, not false.
original_dispatch_contract.binding_receipt: Opus freezes release/cohort, source/quote scope, selected pilot/family, structure/expression policy, model objective and exact consumer claims before dispatch and before relevant outcomes are inspected. Record nonapplicable values explicitly with reason.

rule_operators.in: Scalar binding must equal one listed value.

original_dispatch_contract.additional_receipts: Every matched rule additional_receipt is mandatory, including path-specific probability experiments not represented by a separate parent row.
original_dispatch_contract.build_vs_activation: Research construction may precede scientific promotion. Any score, rank, recommendation, issue or action effect requires its exact accepted OPT-094 successor/consumer contract; do not add a cyclic build dependency to manufacture authority.
original_dispatch_contract.closeout: OPT-103 requires dispositions for every OPT-001..102. OPT-104 is continuing operation. Negative science is a valid terminal research return; a missing product/parity obligation precludes unqualified full completion.

binding_procedure: Choose the exact original task and bounded consumer; retain every unconditional dependency.
Read actual source/capability/rights/quote/model/release lineage before choosing values.
Materialize all fields referenced by that task's conditional rules through the current owner's accepted binding representation. This file's prose policies are not invented runtime enum values.
Record exact values, meaning, input artifact/revision, evidence for each nonmatching value, matched rules and every additional receipt before dispatch and before relevant outcomes.
Apply matching rules cumulatively, including their requires and additional_receipt. An empty requires list is not an empty gate.
Treat unknown, unbound, contradictory or out-of-domain values as blocked for that dispatch. Continue independent ready work.
Do not instantiate a deferred research task with a fake nonmatching value such as later; keep it explicitly not dispatched.
Reuse unchanged accepted receipts only within their actual head/domain. Record new source/policy changes under the original owner.
